%1$s Kanpa ñawpak rurayta wakaychinkapak, AN Paint kunan mana payllatak shuyuta wakaychinchu. Kanpa ñawpak rurayta wakaychinkapak, “Wakaychishkakuna → Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak wakaychina…” nishkata akllay. Kanpa kunan rurayta wakaychinkapak, “Wakaychishkakuna → Imashina wakaychinata akllana…” nishkata akllay (PNG / JPEG).

%1$s AN Paint kanpa ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak chikan wakaychirka. “Wakaychishkakuna → Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak wakaychina…” nishkata akllay. ZIP ukumanta canvas.png nishka shuyuta surkuy. Chay shuyuta paskankapak “Wakaychishkakuna → Shuyuta paskana…” nishkata akllay. Mutsurikpi, “Allichina → Shuyuna kiti → Shuyupa tuputa tikrachina…” nishkata akllay.
PNG / JPEG: Mana shuyuta rurayta usharkachu.
Shuyukunapa tantachiy: AN Paint kay rurayta wakaychiyta mana usharkachu.
Shuyukunapa tantachiy: AN Paint wakaychishka rurayta paskayta mana usharkachu: %1$s
Shuk shuyuta akllay. Ashtawan shuyukunatapash akllayta ushanki.
Shuyupa tupukunapa yupaykuna 0-manta ashtawan hatun kachun.
Ñawpak tupumanta mana ashtawan hatun tupukunata akllay.
0-manta ashtawan hatun tupukunata killkay. Ñawpak tupumanta mana ashtawan hatun kachun.
0-manta ashtawan hatun yupaykunata killkay. Patakpash aksipash shuk pixelmanta mana ashtawan uchilla kachun.
Mushuk tupupak 0-manta ashtawan hatun yupayta churay.
AN Paint payllatak kanpa rurayta wakaychikun…
Kay %1$s ukupi %2$s shuyukuna tiyan. AN Paint mana kuyurik shuyukunata allichin; kuyuriyta mana wakaychinchu.
Shukniki shuyullatami AN Paint churanka. Wakaychishpaka mana kuyurik shuyuta ruranka.
Kay PNG ukupi ña akllashka shuk chikan shuyu tiyan. Kuyurik shuyukunapa rantika chay shuyutami AN Paint churanka. Wakaychishpaka mana kuyurik shuyuta ruranka.

Kay %1$s-ta tantiyankapak ancha sinchimi; ukupi shukmanta ashtawan shuyu tiyanchu mana tiyanchu, mana yachayta ushanchu. AN Paint mana kuyurik shuyullata paskanka; ima kuyuriytapash mana wakaychankachu.
Kay ruraypak RAM mana paktanchu. Shuyukunapa tantachiypak wakaychishka ñawpak shuyukunataka AN Paint charinrakmi.
Ñawpak tupupi kay rurayta rurankapak RAM mana paktanchu. AN Paint mana payllatak shuyupa tuputa tikrachirkachu.
Kay shuyuta paskayta tukuchinkapak RAM mana paktanchu
Kay shuyuta rikunkapak RAM mana paktanchu
Kunan ruraypak churashka RAM-pakka ancha hatunmi. Tupukunata uchillachiy, mana kashpaka kay rurayta sakiy, RAM-pi kitita kachariy.
Android kay shuyuta paskayta mana usharkachu.
Kuchushka kitipa patakpash aksipash shuk pixelmanta mana ashtawan uchilla kachun.
Kuchunapak yupaykuna 0 kachun, mana kashpaka 0-manta ashtawan hatun kachun.
%1$s-ta chikan wakaychirka. Kanpa tukuy shuyupi manarak wakaychishka allichiykuna tiyan; shuyuta shuktakwan rantichinapak ñawpa, tukuy shuyupa kikinllata wakaychiy.
Chikan wakaychirka. Katinkapak ñawpa, kunan shuyuta wakaychinkapak “Wakaychina” mana kashpaka “Imashina wakaychinata akllana…” nishkata akllay.
Shuk iconota, Base64 killkata mana kashpaka ASCII shuyuta chikan wakaychina. Kashna chikan wakaychishpaka kunan shuyutapash “Wakaychina” nishkapa wakaychina kititapash mana tikrachinchu.

Shuyupa wakaychiy samitapash willayta ñitishpa wakaychinapak akllashkakunatapash akllay. “Wakaychina” nishkata akllashpaka kikin shutitapash, maypi wakaychinatapash, samitapash, akllashkakunatapash kutin churanka.
Kan akllashka kitipi shuyupa kikinllata wakaychiy; chay kipaka rakinakunkapak shuk appta akllay. “Wakaychina” nishkapa kunan wakaychina kitita mana tikrachinchu.
Shuyuta wakaychirka, shinapash Android rakinakuyta paskayta mana usharkachu: %1$s
Tukuchishka shuyuta akllashka wakaychina kitipi churayta mana usharkachu.
Allichiykunata kutichinkapak willayta wakaychiyta mana ushanchu. Kanpa Android-pi wakaychinkapak kitita kachariy, kutin ruray.
Allichiykunata kutichinkapak wakaychishka willaypi mana shuyashka willay tiyan.
Shuyuta kutichirka, shinapash allichiykunata kutichinkapak willayta paskayta mana usharkachu. Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak chikan wakaychirka.

Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak ZIP-ta wakaychirka. ZIP ukumanta canvas.png-ta surkuy; “Wakaychishkakuna → Shuyuta paskana…” nishkawan paskay. ZIP ukupi ruraypa akllashkakunapash tiyan. Shuyuman manarak tantachishka akllashka kiti tiyakpika, chaypash ZIP ukupi tiyan.

Hawa lluki kuchumanta pixelkunata kikin kitipillapi charin. Shuyuna kitita uchillachishpaka alli mana kashpaka uray manyamanta kanchapi kak pixelkunata anchuchin; “Ñawpak rurayman kutichina” nishkaka chaykunata kutichin.
PDF pankakunamanta 144 dpi tupupi shuyuta ruran. Killkapash vector shuyukunapash pixelkunaman tikrarin.
Achikpash yanapash rikurik unanchakunawan killkallata ruran. Sapan unancha kikin patakta charik killka samiwan rikuy. Kayka killkawan rurashka shuyumi; ñawpak shuyu hina kutin paskayta mana ushanchu.
Shuyupa willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) wakaychiyta mana kashpaka kutichiyta mana usharkachu. Ña wakaychishka willayta charinrakmi. Kutin ruray.
Kay shuyupa willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) yapashpaka rurayta kutichinkapak ancha hatun kanka. Kanpa ñawpak shuyutapash willaytapash charinrakmi.
Shuyupa wakaychishka wakin willayta (rurakpa shuti, maymanta shamushka, licencia, shuktak killkakuna) paskayta mana usharkachu. Wakaychishkakunata charinrakmi.
Shuyupakpash wakaychinkapak willayta rurana RAM kitikunapakpash mutsurishka RAM tantachishkaka chikan wakaychinkapak churashka RAM-manta ashtawan hatunmi.
Mana kuyurik shuyu; 256 tullpukama. Dithering tullpumanta tullpuman tikrayta llampuyachin. Kuyurik GIF-kunamanta shukniki shuyullata paskan.
Shutita killkay: ama /, \\ nishkakunata churaychu; ama kamachik unanchakunata (control characters) churaychu.
Ashtawan alli shuyu kachun akllashpaka ashtawan ñutu willaykunata wakaychin. Ashtawan kutinkunapi wakaychishka shuyu ashtawan achka wakaychina kitita hapin.

Kay shuyuka tullpukunata imashina rikuchinata willak willayta charin; AN Paint chay willayta manarak tikrachiyta ushanchu. Kaypi churankapak ñawpa, tullpukunapa chay willayta ushashpa shuyuta allichik appwan sRGB PNG-man tikrachiy.

Kay shuyukunapa tantachiyta rurankapak kunan churashka RAM-manta ashtawan RAM mutsurinka nishpa yupashkami, ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurashpapash. Kunan churashka RAM-wanka tantachiypa tupukunata uchillachishpalla mana paktanchu. Kutin rurankapak ñawpa, shuktak paskashkakunata wichkay mana kashpaka ashtawan uchilla ñawpak shuyuta allichiy. Kanpa tantachiy mana tikrarishkachu.

%1$d × %2$d pixels (%3$.2f MP) allita allichinkapak kunan sakishka %4$.2f MP tupumanta ashtawan hatunmi. AN Paint tukuy shuyuta RAM-pi charin; shuyuta tikrachinkapakpash akllashka kitikunapakpash kitita sapanlla charin. Kunan ushana RAM-mi kay tuputa kamachin. Ancha hatun shuyupak RAM kitita manarak churashpa kay rurayta sakirka. AN Paint mana payllatak shuyupa tuputa tikrachirkachu.
Ashtawan alli shuyu kachun akllashpaka, ashtawan kutinkunapi wakaychishka shuyu ashtawan achka wakaychina kitita hapin. Lossless-wanka tullpupa sapan yupayta mana tikrachishpa wakaychin.

Yupashka RAM ukupi kunan shuyuna kitipakpash, llutankapak wakaychishka shuyupakpash (clipboard), tukuy shuyuta ashalla pixelkunawan paskankapakpash (sampled decoding), allichinkapakpash RAM kitikuna tiyan. Chikan ruraypi ushashka RAM tikrarin. Ashtawan uchilla kikin shuyupi ñutu willaykuna chinkan. Ñawpak wakaychishka mana tikrarinchu.
AN Paintpa shimi\n\nAN Paintpa shimi willaykunapi tikrachishka killkakunata wakaychin. Mushuk killkapash manarak tikrachishka killkapash inglés shimipi rikurin.
Ñawpak tullpu: %1$s; washa tullpu: %2$s. Tullpu tantachiy: %3$s.
Shuk kitita kikinllata ruray, mana kashpaka “Shuyuna → Churana → Shuktak shuyukuna” nishkata akllay.
Shuyupa tullpukunata tikrachik hillay kallariyta mana usharkachu. Shuyuta mana churarkachu.
Shuyupi tullpukunapa mana alli willay tiyan, mana kashpaka AN Paint chay willaywan rurayta mana ushanchu.
Shuyupa wakaychishka willayka tukurin; tullpukunapa willayka manarak tukushkachu.
Kay shuyuka ICC tullpu samita charin; shuyuta paskak hillay chayta tikrachiyta mana ushanchu. Ñawpash, tullpukunapa willayta ushashpa shuyuta allichik appwan RGB kikin shuyuta chikan wakaychiy.
SVG-pa ñawpak tupuka Android-pa bitmap shuyukunapak sakishka tupumanta ashtawan hatunmi. Tuputa mana tikrachirkachu.
SVG-pi AN Paint rurankapak alli ñawpak tupu mana nishkachu. Shuyuna kitipa tuputa chaypa rantika mana churarkachu.
Kay wakaychishkaka churankapak sakishka 512 MiB-manta ashtawan hatunmi. Ashtawan uchilla wakaychishkata akllay.
Android wakaychishkakunata akllak hillayta mana tarirkachu. Android-pa allichinakunapi “Files” mana kashpaka “Documents” appta ushayta sakiy; kutin ruray.
Ashtawan uchilla kikin shuyuta rurankapak akllay. Ñawpak shuyukunapa pixel tupukunata mana tikrachinchu. Kuchunapak akllashkakunatapash mana tikrachinchu.
Kay wakaychiy samiwan tupukunata tikrachinkapak ñawpa, ñawpak shuyuta mana kashpaka shuyupa rakikunata RAM-pi paskana kan. Ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurashpapash, kunan ushana RAM mana paktanman.
Ashtawan uchilla shuyuta rurankapak akllashpapash, kunan sakishka RAM-wanka kay shuyuta allichinkapak paskayta mana ushanchu. Kay rurayta sakiy; ashtawan uchilla ñawpak shuyuta churay.
Shuyuta paskankapakpash allichinkapak RAM kitikunapakpash %1$s RAM mutsurin nishpa yupashkami; allita allichinkapak kunan churashka RAM-ka %2$s-mi. Ashtawan uchilla kikin shuyuta akllay.

Tukuy shuyupakpash ruraypak RAM kitikunapakpash mutsurishka RAM-ka kunan allita rurankapak churashka RAM-manta yallin, mana kashpaka Android chay RAM kitikunata churayta mana usharkachu. Kikin shuyupa tuputa tikrachiy, chayta allichinkapak. Ñawpak wakaychishka mana tikrarinkachu.
Akllak hillay wakaychishkata mana apachirkachu. Ama shina kaychu, wakaychishkata kutin akllay.
Akllashka apachik hillay shuyupa ima willaytapash mana apachirkachu.
Kay wakaychishkata AN Paint shuyu hina paskayta mana ushanchu. PNG, JPEG, JPEG XL, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, BMP, GIF, DIB, TIFF, ICO, PDF mana kashpaka shuyupa Base64 killkata churay.
Ama shina kaychu, shuktak wakaychishkata mana kashpaka shuktak kitita akllay.
%1$s-manta %2$s-kama shuk hunta yupayta killkay (decimal piti illak).
Shuyuna kitipa tupukunapak 0-manta ashtawan hatun yupaykunata killkay. Android-pa kiti yupaykunapak sakishka ashtawan hatun yupaymanta sapan tupuka mana yalli kachun.
Kuchunapak tupukuna sapan shuyupa ukupi kachun; hunta pixelkunata mana kashpaka patsak pitikunata churay.
Tullpu tantachiy. Ñawpak tullputa akllankapak llankay; washa tullputa akllankapak llankashpalla chaririy. Ashtawan tullpukunata rikunkapak aysay.
Tullpu #%1$s. Ñawpak tullputa akllankapak llankay; washa tullputa akllankapak llankashpalla chaririy.
Kuchushka kiti shuyuna kitipa ukullapi kachun.
Kuchuyta ñawpash rikuna. Shuk manyata mana kashpaka kuchuta aysay; kuchuna kitita kuyuchinkapak ukupi aysay.
Hillay samikuna. Ashtawan hillaykunata rikunkapak aysay

Shuyuna kiti. Ishkay rukakunata tantachishpa mana kashpaka karuyachishpa rikuna tuputa tikrachiy; ishkay rukakunawan aysashpa rikuna kitita kuyuchiy. “Rikuna kitita kuyuchina” akllashkapika shuk rukawanpash aysayta ushanki.
Ishkay rukakunawan rikuna tuputa tikrachina, rikuna kitita kuyuchina

Pataktapash aksitapash kikin patsak pitiwan tikrachina
Shuyupa tuputa tikrachin. Pataktapash aksitapash chikan tikrachinkapak, “Pataktapash aksitapash kikin patsak pitiwan tikrachina” nishkapa akllayta anchuchiy.

%1$s AN Paint kanpa ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak chikan wakaychirka. Chayta wakaychinkapak “Wakaychishkakuna → Ñawpak rurayta kutichinkapak wakaychina…” nishkata akllay. Ukupi tiyakkuna waklishka kanman, mana kashpaka chaykunata paskayta mana ushanmanchu. Chikan wakaychishkata ZIP shina paskayta ushakpika, ukupi tiyashka canvas.png nishka shuyutapash paskayta ushakpika, chay shuyuta surkuy; “Wakaychishkakuna → Shuyuta paskana…” nishkawan paskay.
